placements.why: The envelope's entire content is about spectrograph calibration — establishing, verifying, and recording it as settled. No existing strata category covers this organizational domain, so a new top-level strata category is warranted.
placements.title: Calibration
placements.frame: How is instrument calibration established, verified, and recorded?

placements.title: Calibration Verified Against Reference Plates
placements.frame: How is instrument calibration verified and recorded as settled?
placements.why: Both expressions cohere around a single thematic subject: the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates and asserted to hold across the full observing band. src-1 performs the technical assertion of verified calibration; src-2 ratifies it as a decision record. This is a theme future envelopes will keep feeding — how calibration gets verified and settled — not a one-time fact, so it earns a narrative leaf under the Calibration strata.
